name: teams
description: Microsoft Teams connector — list teams/channels and post channel messages via Microsoft Graph

ai.insodimension.dimension.title: Microsoft Teams
examples: Post the release notes to the #general channel in the Engineering team
Which channels does the Marketing team have?

setup.title: Register an app in Microsoft Entra (Azure AD)
setup.detail: Azure Portal → App registrations → New registration. Name it "Dimension Teams", leave the default single-tenant option, and register — no redirect URI is needed for app-only access.

setup.title: Copy the tenant and client IDs
setup.detail: On the app's Overview page, copy the Directory (tenant) ID and the Application (client) ID — you'll paste both into the form below.

setup.title: Create a client secret
setup.detail: Certificates & secrets → New client secret → set an expiry → Add. Copy the secret VALUE immediately — Azure shows it only once and it disappears after you leave the page.

setup.title: Grant Graph application permissions + admin consent
setup.detail: API permissions → Add a permission → Microsoft Graph → Application permissions. Add Group.Read.All, Channel.ReadBasic.All, and ChannelMessage.Send, then click "Grant admin consent for <tenant>" (requires a tenant admin). Without admin consent every tool call fails with a 401.

setup.title: Paste your credentials below
setup.detail: Enter the Directory (tenant) ID, Application (client) ID, and the client secret value. They stay on this machine.

form.label: Directory (tenant) ID
form.help: From your app registration's Overview page in the Azure Portal — a GUID like 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.

form.label: Application (client) ID
form.help: Also on the app's Overview page — identifies your Azure AD application.

form.label: Client secret value
form.help: The VALUE (not the Secret ID) created under Certificates & secrets. Azure shows it once — if you lost it, create a new client secret. Stored only on this machine.

tools.name: teams_list_teams
tools.description: List the Microsoft Teams in the connected Azure AD tenant. Returns id/name/description per line.

tools.name: teams_list_channels
tools.description: List the channels of a Microsoft Team (by team id). Returns id/displayName per line.

tools.name: teams_send_channel_message
tools.description: Post a message to a Teams channel. DESTRUCTIVE — confirm team, channel, and text first. App-only sending needs ChannelMessage.Send with admin consent and may be tenant-restricted.

tools.name: teams_read_channel_messages
tools.description: Read recent messages in a Teams channel. Returns sender · timestamp · text (HTML stripped, truncated) per message. App-only reading needs ChannelMessage.Read.All with admin consent (else 403).

tools.name: teams_reply_channel_message
tools.description: Reply to a message in a Teams channel. DESTRUCTIVE — confirm team, channel, target message, and text first. App-only sending needs ChannelMessage.Send with admin consent and may be tenant-restricted.

tools.name: teams_list_members
tools.description: List the members of a Microsoft Team. Returns displayName · roles per line. Needs TeamMember.Read.All with admin consent (else 403).
